Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.regionserver

Class TestDataTieringManager

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.regionserver.TestDataTieringManager
public class TestDataTieringManager extends Object
This class is used to test the functionality of the DataTieringManager. The mock online regions are stored in testOnlineRegions. For all tests, the setup of testOnlineRegions occurs only once. Please refer to setupOnlineRegions() for the structure. Additionally, a list of all store files is maintained in hStoreFiles. The characteristics of these store files are listed below:
